mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which tends to boost equity markets by reducing borrowing costs and increasing risk appetite, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate signals labor market weakness, which can lead to economic downturns and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in >60% of periods following a 0.5pp UNRATE increase.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth indicates a robust economy, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is strong but S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth accelerates and unemployment decreases, it signals a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 2% and UNRATE decrease >0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: If the joint condition is met but S&P 500 returns are not positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production suggests strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production growth is strong but S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising unemployment and higher federal funds rates signal tightening conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases >0.3pp and FEDFUNDS increases >0.5pp in 6 months
failure_condition: If the joint condition is met but S&P 500 returns are not negative in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If housing starts increase by >5% but S&P 500 returns are not positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate indicates tight monetary conditions, which can lead to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 4% but S&P 500 returns are not negative in >60% of cases.
